annotations.title: US federal per diem rates for a place

description: What are the GSA per diem rates (lodging and meals & incidentals) for a US city, county or ZIP on a date or for a fiscal year? More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

city.description: City or town (with state). A GSA destination name, a GSA city-limits area, or any Census place; a place GSA does not name gets its county's rate.

county.description: County, parish or Virginia independent city (with state): "Fairfax", "Fairfax County", "City of Richmond".

did.description: GSA destination ID of a non-standard area (from GET /locations).

fy.description: Fiscal year (2026 or 2027) instead of a date: no single-day rate, all months.

state.description: Two-letter code or name (with city or county). CONUS only: the 48 contiguous states and DC.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code (ZIP+4 is fine), as a string. Follows GSA's ZIP code file.
